title: Savings & Money Market Accounts: relationship bonus and goal bonus rates by tier
content:
## Scope

This rate card lists, for each tier of Savings & Money Market Accounts, the relationship bonus and the goal bonus: the percentage points each adds and the values that bound them.

## Relationship bonus

Definitions:

- **Relationship bonus APY**: percentage points added to the base APY when the customer holds a qualifying checking tier.
- **Qualifying checking tiers**: the checking tiers that qualify the account for the relationship bonus; "none" means no checking tier qualifies.
- **Relationship bonus balance cap**: the largest combined savings balance, across all of the customer's savings accounts, on which the relationship bonus is paid, in USD.

| Tier | Relationship bonus APY | Qualifying checking tiers | Relationship bonus balance cap |
|---|---|---|---|
| Starter Savings | 0.00 points | none | USD 0.00 |
| Statement Savings | 0.05 points | Everyday Checking, Interest Checking, Premier Checking, Private Client Checking | USD 25000.00 |
| Goal Builder Savings | 0.10 points | Everyday Checking, Interest Checking, Premier Checking, Private Client Checking | USD 25000.00 |
| Money Market Account | 0.15 points | Interest Checking, Premier Checking, Private Client Checking | USD 100000.00 |
| Premier Money Market | 0.25 points | Premier Checking, Private Client Checking | USD 250000.00 |
| Private Client Money Market | 0.25 points | Private Client Checking | USD 1000000.00 |

## Goal bonus

Definitions:

- **Goal bonus APY**: percentage points added for a statement cycle in which the goal conditions are met; 0.00 means the goal bonus is not offered.
- **Goal bonus minimum net deposit**: net deposits in the cycle at or above which the goal bonus is earned, in USD.
- **Goal bonus balance cap**: the largest daily balance on which the goal bonus is paid, in USD.

| Tier | Goal bonus APY | Goal bonus minimum net deposit | Goal bonus balance cap |
|---|---|---|---|
| Starter Savings | 0.00 points | not offered | not offered |
| Statement Savings | 0.00 points | not offered | not offered |
| Goal Builder Savings | 1.75 points | USD 50.00 | USD 25000.00 |
| Money Market Account | 0.00 points | not offered | not offered |
| Premier Money Market | 0.00 points | not offered | not offered |
| Private Client Money Market | 0.00 points | not offered | not offered |

## Points of judgement

**Does a Starter Savings account earn a relationship bonus?** No; its relationship bonus is 0.00 points and it lists no qualifying checking tier.

**Which tiers offer a goal bonus?** Only Goal Builder Savings; every other tier reads 0.00 points, which means not offered.

**A customer holds Everyday Checking. Which tiers can earn a relationship bonus from it?** Statement Savings and Goal Builder Savings; the three money market tiers do not list Everyday Checking.
